output.title: Nightly batch ELT
output.description: Airflow runs a nightly Airbyte sync from app, CRM and billing sources into Snowflake, then dbt builds marts for Tableau.

simulations.title: The nightly run
simulations.description: Extract and load 300 table batches, then build 120 dbt models. Time is compressed: an hour takes a few seconds.

action.text: 02:00. Airflow starts the nightly DAG: Airbyte copies whatever changed since yesterday from three sources into raw tables.
03:00. The load is done, so dbt rebuilds the marts and runs its tests. A failing test posts to Slack.
06:00. Tableau refreshes. Simple and cheap, but dashboards show yesterday. Compare the event-driven data platform, where rows land in seconds.

expectations.label: A failing test alerts the team

simulations.title: Slow source, stale marts
simulations.description: Salesforce throttles the bulk API, the load overruns, and dbt starts on schedule with partial data.

action.text: Tonight Salesforce throttles its bulk API, so every sync runs about three times slower.
03:00 arrives and the load isn't finished. A time-based schedule starts dbt anyway, so some marts are built from partial data.
The fix: make dbt wait for the load (a sensor or a data-aware schedule), or stream the data so there's no window to miss.
